name: desktop-ux
source: design-20261018.md revision 2 sections 3 to 6 and 8.2; root-decisions-20261019.md D2
units: Lengths are dp after the app zoom unless a key says px, dip, sp, ms, percent or hz. dp = physical px / (windows_scale x app_zoom). Derived integers are rounded half to even from exact rational arithmetic, as in the spec tables (Kotlin: kotlin.math.round, never roundToInt).
regenerate: python desktop/tools/ux/ux_model.py --write recomputes every derived value (displays.derived and derived_status, resolved golden widths, derive_status, every expect) and rewrites this file and the Kotlin test copy. A status is measured only when every input is: the maximised height rests on the assumed maximised_chrome_dip.

common.maximised_chrome_note: Caption bar plus taskbar in Windows DIP. Chosen so the spec 4K row is 1101 dp high (assumed; a real-window item).

window.unit: AWT frame bounds as java.awt.Window reports them; sanity limits only, clamping to a visible monitor is W3

notes: Defaults are the first listed value of each flag in spec 5.2, which agrees with the stated defaults (rail_mode AUTO, player_layout LEGACY) and with spec 6.8 (wheel VOLUME, click PAUSE, double click FULLSCREEN).
Spec 5.2 states no default for home_layout and card_interactions: the first listed value (DESKTOP, ON) is used. Nothing reads either flag in X0; H1 and H2 decide whether they ship on.
player_layout stays LEGACY until the user accepts the real-window list; the flip is one constant.
A missing key follows the default. An explicit choice is stored as an explicit key and survives a later default flip.

rules.tier_basis: exact video width, not the rounded one

pointer.fine_scrub_note: Spec 4.6 names the knots; the curve between them is decided by X1b and must be monotone with a floor of 0.1.

rules: no duplicate chord inside a scope
no bare printable key in the shell scope
no chord with both Ctrl and Alt (AltGr)
no Ctrl chord on a zoom decoder key
a chord used by two scopes has the same action or is listed in dual_meaning

rows.note: popup first, then leave fullscreen; windowed behaviour is decision D4

control_bar.about: The LEGACY player control bar restyled with the kit (slice V2b, spec 4.5, 4.13 and 5.1). The layout and menu numbers that the bar had before the restyle stay (the two breakpoints, the menu floor and limits); the rest follow the kit tokens: the pill and the menu rows are the kit control height, the slider row is the kit list row height (the bar sets that height on the row), the gap between two buttons is the spec dock gap. Every menu height adds a 4 dp rounding slack to the exact content height, because Compose rounds each padding to whole pixels and at the density 1.875 the two 4 dp paddings of the menu host cost 16 px against a budget of 15. A hint is the key a tooltip names: its chord must be an active row of shortcuts.rows with the same action.

player_keys.about: Slice V6 (spec 6.5 and 6.6): the window-level shortcut input of the ordinary video page. key_codes maps the AWT virtual key code of a press to the key name of the chords above (shortcuts.rows). The rest are the numbers and sets of the pure part (DesktopPlayerShortcutEffects.kt). vendored is generated from the real vendored map by ux_vendored_player_keys.py --write, never edited: every binding of resolvePlayerKeyAction is kept, changed, not-taken or dropped, and the intentional differences carry their reason.

owned_elsewhere.Space: DesktopWindowsVideoKeyInput claims Space (and Esc in fullscreen); the router never claims Space

not_performed.ESC_CHAIN: claimed by the router itself, decision D4, never by an effect
not_performed.VIDEO_INFO: slice V8: the video info card does not exist yet
not_performed.SUBTITLE_FLYOUT: slice V1 and V5: the subtitle flyout does not exist yet
not_performed.CONTEXT_MENU: slice V5: the context menu does not exist yet
not_performed.SHORTCUT_HELP: slice V8: the shortcut help sheet does not exist yet
not_performed.FRAME_STEP: omitted until an MpvPlayer API exists

state_rules.vendored: only a key press is read
state_rules.router: the resolver reads key presses only; the release of a claimed press is consumed by the input
the leaf claims no key while the page is not the current source, which includes picture-in-picture

state_rules.vendored: no key while a text input is active
state_rules.router: the resolver gets textEditorFocused and the leaf passes the focus owner test of a Swing text component

state_rules.vendored: screen locked: only L, which unlocks
state_rules.router: there is no screen lock on the desktop

state_rules.vendored: Ctrl, Alt or Meta held: no action
state_rules.router: the Ctrl and Alt chords of the table are claimed (Ctrl+Left, Ctrl+Right, Ctrl+B, Alt+Enter); Meta and Ctrl+Alt never

shell_host.about: Slice S2: the shell shortcut host (ui/DesktopShellShortcutHost.kt) that wires the shell rows of shortcuts to the Root key handler. Mirrored by ux_shell_model.py (host section) and checked by test_ux_shell_shortcut_host.py and DesktopShellShortcutHostTest.

back.idle_at: the Home tab at the root of the stack

shell_host.editor_focus: a Swing text component, or a focus owner (or parent) whose getInputMethodRequests is not null
